The '''''Enforcer''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was shot down in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Conspicuous Gallantry">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Conspicuous Gallantry|Hoth}}</ref> in [[3665 BBY]].<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
